column4: 这本书含有很多有用的信息。
column5: This book contains a lot of useful information.
column6: 含有 is used for a thing that has something inside it: 含有糖 (contains sugar), 含有很多信息 (contains a lot of information). The negative is 不含有.

column5: His face is covered in sweat.
column6: 汗水 is sweat. It is also used for hard work: 用汗水换来成功 (to earn success through sweat).

column5: Which industry does he work in?
column6: 行业 is a line of business, such as education or the food industry. 行 is read háng here.

column4: 这部电影得到了很多好评。
column5: This film has received a lot of praise.
column6: 好评 is a positive comment or review: 得到好评, 获得好评, 好评很多.

column5: Good luck to you!
column6: 好运 is good luck. 祝你好运 is what you say to wish someone luck.

column3: to improve; to take a turn for the better
column5: His illness has already got better.
column6: 好转 is for something bad that starts to get better: 病情好转 (the patient's condition improves), 天气好转 (the weather improves).

column4: 孩子们对什么都很好奇。
column5: Children are curious about everything.
column6: 好奇 means wanting to know or see something new: 对……很好奇 (to be curious about …).

column3: to close; to join; to fit
column5: He closed the book.
column6: 合 means "to close" (合上书), "to join" (合作, 合影) or "to fit" (合适, 合脚).

column5: Is it legal to do this?
column6: 合法 means allowed by the law. The opposite is 不合法.

column5: At noon we eat boxed meals.
column6: 盒饭 is a meal sold in a box, often cheap and quick: 买盒饭 (to buy a boxed meal), 一份盒饭.

column5: This price is very reasonable.
column6: 合理 means fitting good reasons: 合理的要求 (a reasonable request), 合理安排 (to arrange sensibly).

column5: This place has many rivers.
column6: 河流 is a general word for rivers. For one river people say 河: 一条河.

column5: This contract has three pages.
column6: 合同 is a written contract between two sides: 工作合同 (a work contract), 合同结束 (the contract ends).

column3: to take a group photo; group photo
column4: 毕业的时候，大家一起合影。
column5: At graduation, everyone takes a group photo together.
column6: 合影 is a verb (和老师合影) and a noun (一张合影, a group photo).

column4: 我们两个公司合作得很好。
column5: Our two companies cooperate very well.
column6: 合作 is to work with others for the same goal: 和……合作 (to cooperate with …), 合作愉快 (here's to a good partnership).

column5: It has got dark; let us go home.
column6: 黑 means black (黑头发) and dark (天黑了, 房间很黑). 黑板 is a blackboard.

column5: The apple is ripe and has turned red.
column6: 红 means red: 红花, 脸红了 (to blush). It is also used for popular: 他很红 (he is very popular).

column4: 动物园里的猴子很可爱。
column5: The monkeys in the zoo are very cute.
column6: 猴子 is a monkey. The measure word is 只: 一只猴子.

column4: 这本书的厚度只有两厘米。
column5: The thickness of this book is only two centimetres.
column6: 厚度 is how thick something is. 厚 means "thick"; the opposite is 薄.

column5: The consequences of doing this are very serious.
column6: 后果 usually means a bad result: 后果严重 (serious consequences), 想一想后果 (to think about the consequences).

column4: 我们不能忽视这个问题。
column5: We cannot ignore this problem.
column6: 忽视 is to pay too little attention to something important: 忽视安全 (to overlook safety).

column4: 山上的空气很好，呼吸很舒服。
column5: The air on the mountain is good, and breathing is comfortable.
column6: 呼吸 is "to breathe" and also "breathing": 深呼吸 (to take a deep breath), 呼吸新鲜空气 (to breathe fresh air).

column5: There is a big lake in the park.
column6: 湖 is a lake: 湖边 (the lakeside), 湖水 (lake water). The measure word is 个 or 片.

column5: There are many butterflies in the garden.
column6: 蝴蝶 is a butterfly. The measure word is 只: 一只蝴蝶.

column4: 中国的老城市里有很多胡同。
column5: There are many hutongs in China's old cities.
column6: 胡同 is a narrow old street in a northern city, especially Beijing: 一条胡同.

column5: Teachers and students often interact.
column6: 互动 is when two sides act on each other: 互动活动 (an interactive activity). It can also be a noun: 很多互动 (a lot of interaction).

column4: 周末我们喜欢去户外运动。
column5: At the weekend we like to go and do sports outdoors.
column6: 户外 means outside, in the open air: 户外活动 (outdoor activities), 户外运动.

column4: 这次旅行花费了不少钱。
column5: This trip has cost a lot of money.
column6: 花费 is to spend money, time or effort: 花费时间. As a noun it is the cost: 花费很大.

column5: After the rain, the road is slippery.
column6: 滑 means "slippery" (地很滑) and "to slide" (滑冰, 滑雪).

column5: We rowed a boat to the middle of the lake.
column6: 划 is read huá as "to row" (划船) and "to scratch". In 计划 (plan) it is read huà.

column4: 这个城市越来越现代化。
column5: This city is getting more and more modern.
column6: 化 is added to a word to mean "to turn into": 现代化 (modernisation), 简单化 (to simplify). In 变化 and 文化 it is part of the word.

column4: 这个月的话费是八十块。
column5: This month's phone bill is eighty yuan.
column6: 话费 is the money you pay for calls and your phone plan: 交话费 (to pay the phone bill), 话费很高 (the phone bill is high).

column5: The pictures in this film are very beautiful.
column6: 画面 is what you see on a screen or in a painting: 画面清楚 (the picture is clear).

column5: Let us change the topic.
column6: 话题 is a topic people talk about: 换话题 (to change the subject), 有意思的话题.

column5: His chemistry grades are very good.
column6: 化学 is the school subject chemistry. 化学药品 are chemicals.

column4: 考试的每个环节都很重要。
column5: Every stage of the exam is very important.
column6: 环节 is one step in a chain of steps: 重要环节 (a key link), 最后一个环节 (the last part).

column5: Exercise can relieve pressure.
column6: 缓解 is to make something bad less severe: 缓解压力 (to relieve stress), 缓解紧张 (to ease tension).

column5: The train moves forward slowly.
column6: 缓慢 is a written word for slow, usually about movement or speed. The everyday word is 慢.

column5: I like eating cucumbers.
column6: 黄瓜 is a cucumber. The measure word is 根: 一根黄瓜.

column5: Gold is very expensive.
column6: 黄金 is gold the metal. It also means the best time: 黄金时间 (prime time).

column5: There is a lot of dust on the table.
column6: 灰 means "dust" and "ash" (一层灰). As an adjective it means "grey" (灰衣服). The word for the colour is 灰色.

column5: He waves to us.
column6: 挥 is to wave or swing. It is mostly used in 挥手 (to wave the hand) and 发挥 (to bring into play).

column5: His body is recovering very quickly.
column6: 恢复 is to get back to a normal state: 恢复健康 (to recover health), 恢复正常 (to return to normal).

column5: She likes grey clothes.
column6: 灰色 is the colour grey. It is a noun (灰色是我的最爱) and an adjective (灰色的天空).

column5: Old phones can be recycled.
column6: 回收 is to take something back so it can be used again: 回收旧书 (to collect old books), 回收瓶子 (to recycle bottles).

column5: What is today's exchange rate?
column6: 汇率 is the price of one money in another money: 汇率变化 (a change in the exchange rate).

column5: They will hold their wedding next month.
column6: 婚礼 is a wedding ceremony: 举行婚礼 (to hold a wedding), 参加婚礼 (to go to a wedding).

column5: A group of people are singing on the road.
column6: 伙 counts a group of people: 一伙人. It can sound a little like a gang, so 群 is the neutral word.

column5: He is my best partner.
column6: 伙伴 is a companion you do things with: 学习伙伴 (a study partner), 合作伙伴 (a business partner).

column5: In winter we often eat hot pot.
column6: 火锅 is a pot of hot soup on the table where you cook your food as you eat. It is a popular winter dish, especially in Sichuan and Chongqing.

column5: Either tea or coffee is fine.
column6: 或是 means "or" in statements: 茶或是咖啡. It is the same as 或者. In questions people use 还是.

column5: The goods have already been delivered.
column6: 货物 is goods that are carried or sold: 运送货物 (to carry goods), 检查货物 (to check goods).

column5: Perhaps he has already gone home.
column6: 或许 is a written "perhaps". It comes before the verb or the adjective, and is the same as 也许.

column5: This is an educational institution.
column6: 机构 is a formal body such as an office, a bank or a school: 研究机构 (a research institution).

column5: The match is very intense.
column6: 激烈 is for strong competition or argument: 竞争激烈 (fierce competition), 激烈的比赛.

column5: This machine is very old now.
column6: 机器 is a machine. The measure word is 台: 一台机器.

column5: He is making a robot.
column6: 机器人 is a robot. 机器 (machine) + 人 (person).

column5: He exercises every day, and his muscles are big.
column6: 肌肉 is muscle: 锻炼肌肉 (to exercise the muscles), 肌肉很酸 (the muscles are sore).

column5: Both teachers and students must take part.
column6: 及 is a formal "and", used in notices and writing: 老师及学生. It joins nouns, not verbs.

column5: He is a third-grade student.
column6: 级 is a grade or level: 年级 (school year), 高级 (advanced).

column5: This TV series has thirty episodes.
column6: 集 is an episode of a TV series (第一集) or a part of a book. It also means to gather, as in 集合 and 集中.

column4: 很多疾病和生活习惯有关。
column5: Many diseases are related to lifestyle habits.
column6: 疾病 is a formal word for disease. In speech people say 病.

column5: He passed this exam.
column6: 及格 is to reach the pass mark, which is 60 out of 100 in China: 考试及格, 不及格 (to fail).

column4: 请大家八点在门口集合。
column5: Everyone, please gather at the door at eight.
column6: 集合 is to bring people together at a time and place: 在……集合 (to gather at …).

column5: The train is about to arrive at the station.
column6: 即将 means very soon and is written or formal. It goes before a verb: 即将开始 (about to begin).

column4: 听到电话响，他急忙跑了过去。
column5: Hearing the phone ring, he hurriedly ran over.
column6: 急忙 comes before the verb and means "in a hurry": 急忙走, 急忙回答. It is for a single action, not a habit.

column5: This matter is extremely important.
column6: 极其 is a more formal "extremely", used before an adjective: 极其重要, 极其困难. 非常 is the everyday word.

column5: This is a group activity.
column6: 集体 is a group of people who work or live together, as opposed to one person (个人): 集体活动, 集体生活.

column5: This place urgently needs doctors.
column6: 急需 is to need something very badly and quickly: 急需帮助 (to urgently need help).

column4: 他半夜去医院看了急诊。
column5: He went to the hospital's emergency department in the middle of the night.
column6: 急诊 is emergency treatment for a sudden illness: 看急诊 (to go to the emergency room).

column4: 上课的时候要集中注意力。
column5: In class you must concentrate.
column6: 集中 is to gather into one place or point: 集中注意力 (to concentrate), 集中在一起 (to be gathered together).

column5: The underground is very crowded.
column6: 挤 means "crowded" (很挤) and "to squeeze" (挤进去, 挤上去).

column4: 开车的时候要系安全带。
column5: When driving you must fasten your seat belt.
column6: 系 is read jì when it means to fasten or tie. As a noun (a department, a system) it is read xì: 关系 (relationship), 系统 (system), 中文系 (the Chinese department).

column4: 这个季度我们卖了很多手机。
column5: This quarter we sold many phones.
column6: 季度 is one of the four quarters of a year, three months each: 第一季度, 上个季度. It is used for business.

column4: 他把每天的花费记录下来。
column5: He writes down his spending every day.
column6: 记录 is to write down (verb) or a written record (noun): 记录下来, 会议记录 (the minutes of a meeting).

column5: He broke the world record.
column6: 纪录 is the best result ever in a sport: 世界纪录, 打破纪录. 记录 and 纪录 are both read jìlù; 记录 is for notes and data.
